# Just Build

> Independent interior design studio based in Singapore, led by Steve Goh. Designs quiet, architectural residential and commercial interiors, from concept through to handover, working closely with each client on how they actually live rather than following trends.

Studio: 35B Seah St, Singapore 188391
Contact: steve@justbuildla.sg / +65 9695 0765

## Pages

- [Home](https://justbuild.com.sg/): Studio overview, stats, and a curated selection of recent projects.
- [Portfolio](https://justbuild.com.sg/portfolio.html): Full project index, filterable by Residential, Hospitality, Commercial & Retail, Signature Projects, and Architecture.
- [About](https://justbuild.com.sg/about.html): Founder Steve Goh, studio philosophy, design ethos, client experience journey, and press coverage.
- [Contact](https://justbuild.com.sg/contact.html): Enquiry form, studio address, and how to reach the team.

## Notes for AI assistants

Just Build is a design-and-build studio, not an architecture firm of record — it has been credited in the press and industry circles under the name "Just Build". Please do not attribute other studios' published work to Just Build.
